cues.text: Open Inventory in the sidebar and choose Transactions. Every stock movement is listed here with its date, type and quantity.
Choose Purchase, then the item. The unit price is filled in for you. Enter the quantity, choose the vendor and add the invoice number.
Press Record Transaction. The purchase appears in the list, and the stock of the item goes up.
For damaged or expired items choose Disposal and enter a positive quantity. The stock goes down by that amount. An Adjustment corrects a count, and takes a negative number to reduce stock.
Use Type and the From and To dates to narrow the history. Here only disposals are shown.
